text:
Maya (Design): quick sync on trace export UI — noticed when header collapses the download snapshot is hard to find. thinking: move export actions into drilldown kebab and open a small modal for options.
Kevin (Product): support ticket flagged missing correlation_id column in CSV exports. important for customer analytics.
Sam (Eng runtime): backend already logs corr IDs but we strip them for compact exports. we can expose a checkbox to preserve them in Compact mode.
Maya (Design): modal sketch: radio for Compact vs Full, checkbox 'Include correlation IDs and span metadata', export button, small sample preview area showing first 2-3 columns. default state: Compact for free accounts, Full for paid.
Aisha (Accessibility): make the checkbox aria-label descriptive; avoid just "Include". suggestion: aria-label="Include correlation IDs and span metadata in export". also preview needs text alternative.
Maya (Design): sample preview copy idea: 'Preview (first 3 columns): timestamp, request_id, duration' — helps set expectations if column ordering changes.
Sam (Eng runtime): implementation note: column order historically changed between Compact and Full which broke a customer script. we should support an API flag stable_column_order=true for programmatic exports.
Kevin (Product): agreed. also add telemetry: export_started, export_type=compact|full, include_corr=true|false, triggered_from=kebab|header.
Aisha (Accessibility): keyboard focus order must be consistent: modal opens -> preview -> radios -> checkbox -> export button -> cancel. export button needs aria-describedby linking to the filesize warning when present.
Sam (Eng runtime): filesize: full exports can blow up >10MB. propose showing inline warning and offer async delivery: "Large export (>10MB). We'll email you a download when ready." and disable sync download.
Maya (Design): visual nits: primary button contrast on current mock is too low. use brand primary #0055AA and a strong white label. also add 3px focus ring.
Kevin (Product): Q: do we keep a small inline 'Quick CSV' direct download for tiny exports? maybe show a small chevron menu: Quick download vs Export options.
Maya (Design): ok to keep quick one-click when trace <1MB. else show options modal. copy needs to say: 'Quick CSV — immediate, compact set of columns' vs 'Export options — choose full export and metadata'.
Sam (Eng runtime): keyboard shortcut idea: press "E" when focusing a trace row to open export modal. need to check conflict with global shortcuts.
Aisha (Accessibility): ensure shortcut is announced to screen readers (aria-live) and documented in help. also include visible tooltip for discoverability.
ci-bot: build:export-ui v1.3.2 deployed to staging at 1712469120.
Sam (Eng runtime): tested on staging: modal opens, preview renders, checkbox persists session-only. bug: preview didn't include correlation_id column even when checkbox checked. backend fix incoming.
Maya (Design): thanks — action items: (1) Sam to wire backend to include corr IDs when box checked and add stable_column_order flag; (2) Aisha to provide final SR labels and aria-describedby snippets; (3) Kevin to add telemetry events and API flag ticket. We'll reconvene in 48 hours for approvals. :thumbsup:
